correctness.rationale: TARGET route: direct negative resolution via explicit witness. Re-ran inputs/artifacts/verify.py -> VERIFY_OK (geometry 273/65/208/65, 65x16 cliques pairwise<=1, bipartition-consistent, K4=0, alpha>=35>26). Independently recounted with set-based code: symmetric adjacency, 3851 edges, K4=0, 35-set has 0 internal edges over 595 pairs, N/8=26 so violation margin is 9 vertices (alpha/N>=0.168 vs <=0.125). Geometry rebuilt from GF(16)=GF(2)[t]/(t^4+t+1) from scratch matches ledgers. ADMISSION_DEFECT: topic.audit_preflight and admission claim H_4 is 'triangle-free by design'; the filed Section-3 H_q^* instance contains 4916 triangles (independently counted) and is K4-free, not triangle-free. DRAFT correctly discloses this. The defect does not create correctness failure because the verified property needed for R(4,t) and for the alpha-window refutation is K4-freeness plus the independent set, both exactly checked.

originality.rationale: Live fused retrieval over literal, equivalent-encoding, and dominance forms returns only Mattheus-Verstraete asymptotics (arXiv:2306.04007, Annals 2024.199.2.8), expositions, and generic K4-free/pseudorandom notes; no source states alpha or an N/24-N/8 window for any q=4 Hermitian-unital Section-3 instance, let alone the seeded 208-vertex instance. The paper proves r(4,t)=Omega(t^3/log^4 t) for large q with pseudorandomness only for q>=2^40, so it does not imply the finite q=4 upper bound; spectral/polarity bounds leave the window open; no Ramsey table or unital census lists alpha of this randomized host. The 35-set is therefore substantively new, not a recomputation, corollary, or repackaging of a stronger fact.

value.rationale: Rigorous disproof of the admitted window with margin 9 is independently retrievable: it is the first exact extremal fact about the smallest Hermitian-unital R(4,t) host, showing the q=4 Section-3 host is far less pseudorandom (alpha/N>=0.168) than the N/8 (0.125) upper side supposes, consistent with the paper's large-q proviso (q>=2^40). Typicality is evidenced by six further seeds yielding 33-36-sets, so the finding is not a single-seed artifact but a calibration of the algebraic barrier that future book-induction and construction work can reuse. ADMISSION_DEFECT noted above (triangle-free mislabel) does not reduce this to a cheap type/vacuity/lookup mismatch: the refutation is a substantive independence witness, not merely exposing triangles. Exact alpha remains open, honestly limited.
